654    row.audit_head_snapshot_sha256 = record["after_snapshot_sha256"]

578    try:
579        anchor = db.query(AdminCompanyProfileAuditAnchor).filter_by(
580            profile_id=str(profile_id),
581        ).populate_existing().first()
582        legacy_count = anchor.legacy_cutover_revision if anchor else 0
583        if type(legacy_count) is not int or not 0 <= legacy_count <= len(audits):
584            raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("旧历史锚点修订边界非法")
585        legacy = audits[:legacy_count]
586        signed = audits[legacy_count:]
587        if any(not _audit_is_legacy(item) for item in legacy):
588            raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("旧历史不得被补签或改写")
589        if any(_audit_is_legacy(item) for item in signed):
590            raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("企业档案存在未锚定的无签名审计")
591        for item in [*signed, *([anchor] if anchor else [])]:
592            if isinstance(item.key_id, str) and item.key_id not in keyring.key_ids:
593                raise AdminCompanyProfileUnavailable("企业档案历史验证密钥不可用")
594        verify_observed_audit_chain(
595            [AuditSnapshotObservation(
596                record=_signed_audit_record(item), before_snapshot=item.before_snapshot,
597                after_snapshot=item.after_snapshot,
598            ) for item in signed],
599            keyring=keyring, expected_profile_id=str(profile_id),
600            expected_head=AuditChainHead(
601                profile_id=str(profile_id), revision=row.revision,
602                snapshot_sha256=row.audit_head_snapshot_sha256, mac=row.audit_head_mac,
603            ),
604            expected_current_snapshot=_row_snapshot(row),
605            validate_snapshot=_snapshot_content_sha256,
606            legacy_anchor=_anchor_record(anchor) if anchor else None,
607            legacy_audits=[_legacy_audit_record(item) for item in legacy] if anchor else None,
608            legacy_terminal_snapshot=legacy[-1].after_snapshot if legacy else None,
609        )
610        if signed and row.updated_at != signed[-1].created_at:
611            raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("企业档案更新时间与签名审计不一致")
612        if not anchor and row.created_at != audits[0].created_at:
613            raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("企业档案创建时间与签名审计不一致")
614        if signed and row.status == "archived" and row.archived_at != signed[-1].created_at:
615            raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("企业档案归档时间与签名审计不一致")
616        return audits
617    except (AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError, AdminCompanyProfileUnavailable):
618        raise
619    except (CompanyProfileAuditIntegrityError, AdminCompanyProfileValidationError,
620            AttributeError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
621        raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("企业档案签名审计校验失败") from exc

750            updated_by=actor, updated_at=now,
751        ))
752        if result.rowcount != 1:

762        return updated

764        db.rollback()

    248def _load_admin_company_profile_snapshot(db: Session, company_profile_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
249    """Read one active admin profile before streaming and freeze it as JSON.
250 
251    The company-profile CRUD service is the only persistence boundary.  This
252    router deliberately does not accept a profile payload and never falls back
253    to ``companies.json`` when an explicit ID cannot be resolved.
254    """
255    requested_id = str(company_profile_id or "").strip()
256    if not requested_id:
257        raise HTTPException(status_code=HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="company_profile_id 不能为空")
258 
259    try:
260        try:
261            from service.admin_company_profile_service import (
262                AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError,
263                AdminCompanyProfileUnavailable,
264                AdminCompanyProfileNotFound,
265                AdminCompanyProfileValidationError,
266                get_active_profile_snapshot,
267            )
268        except ImportError:
269            from app.service.admin_company_profile_service import (  # type: ignore
270                AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError,
271                AdminCompanyProfileUnavailable,
272                AdminCompanyProfileNotFound,
273                AdminCompanyProfileValidationError,
274                get_active_profile_snapshot,
275            )
276    except ImportError as exc:
277        # Do not silently degrade an explicit managed-profile request to fuzzy
278        # name matching while the CRUD feature is unavailable.
279        logger.error("[research] 管理端企业档案服务不可用", exc_info=True)
280        raise HTTPException(
281            status_code=HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
282            detail="企业档案服务不可用，无法加载指定快照",
283        ) from exc
284 
285    try:
286        snapshot = get_active_profile_snapshot(db, requested_id)
287    except AdminCompanyProfileNotFound as exc:
288        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="企业档案不存在或已归档") from exc
289    except AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError as exc:
290        raise HTTPException(
291            status_code=HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
292            detail=f"企业档案审计连续性校验失败：{exc}",
293        ) from exc
294    except AdminCompanyProfileUnavailable as exc:
295        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="企业档案审计密钥不可用") from exc
296    except AdminCompanyProfileValidationError as exc:
297        raise HTTPException(status_code=HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=f"企业档案快照无效：{exc}") from exc
298 
299    # ``json`` round-trip is intentional.  It both rejects ORM/Pydantic objects
300    # leaking across the streaming boundary and breaks all references to the
301    # active database object before the async generator starts.
302    try:
303        frozen = json.loads(json.dumps(snapshot, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))
304    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
305        raise HTTPException(
306            status_code=HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
307            detail="企业档案服务返回的快照不是纯 JSON",
308        ) from exc
309 
310    if not isinstance(frozen, dict) or set(frozen) != {"profile", "ref", "scenario"}:
311        raise HTTPException(status_code=HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="企业档案快照形状非法")
312    if not isinstance(frozen["profile"], dict) or not isinstance(frozen["ref"], dict):
313        raise HTTPException(status_code=HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="企业档案快照内容非法")
314    if not isinstance(frozen["scenario"], str):
315        raise HTTPException(status_code=HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="企业档案快照场景非法")
316    return frozen

    850def get_active_profile_snapshot(db: Session, profile_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
851    """Return the JSON-only, integrity-checked snapshot consumed by the run-time layer."""
852    row = get_company_profile(db, profile_id, include_archived=False)
853    # Re-run strict persistence validation to avoid making a tampered DB row a
854    # source of an apparently valid no-record conclusion.
855    try:
856        values = _profile_snapshot_values(
857            row.profile_json, row.scenario or "", row.scenario_data or {},
858            row.field_sources or [], row.materials or [],
859        )
860        if _content_sha256(values) != row.content_sha256:
861            raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("企业档案内容哈希不匹配，拒绝作为尽调输入")
862 
863        class _StoredWrite:
864            profile = values["profile"]
865            scenario = values["scenario"]
866            scenario_data = values["scenario_data"]
867            field_sources = values["field_sources"]
868            materials = values["materials"]
869        checked = prepare_company_profile_content(_StoredWrite())
870    except AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError:
871        raise
872    except AdminCompanyProfileValidationError as exc:
873        raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError(f"企业档案内容无法通过严格校验：{exc}") from exc
874    except Exception as exc:
875        raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("企业档案内容无法通过严格校验") from exc
876    if checked["content_sha256"] != row.content_sha256:
877        raise AdminCompanyProfileIntegrityError("企业档案规范化后内容哈希不匹配")
878 
879    ref = {
880        "id": str(row.id), "revision": int(row.revision),
881        "content_sha256": row.content_sha256, "source": "admin_company_profile",
882    }
883    profile = copy.deepcopy(values["profile"])
884    profile["_admin_profile_ref"] = copy.deepcopy(ref)
885    profile["_scenario_data"] = copy.deepcopy(values["scenario_data"])
886    profile["_admin_field_sources"] = copy.deepcopy(values["field_sources"])
887    return {"profile": profile, "ref": ref, "scenario": values["scenario"]}

    535def create_initial_state(
536    query: str,
537    session_id: str,
538    search_web: bool = True,
539    search_local: bool = False,
540    as_of: str = "",
541    kb_scope: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
542    subject_name: str = "",
543    business_type: str = "",
544    due_diligence: Optional[bool] = None,
545    investigation: Optional[bool] = None,
546    provided_company_profile: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
547    admin_profile_ref: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
548    admin_profile_scenario: str = "",
549) -> ResearchState:
550    """创建初始状态
551 
552    Args:
553        query: 用户查询
554        session_id: 会话ID
555        search_web: 是否启用网络搜索（默认True）
556        search_local: 是否启用本地知识库搜索（默认False）
557        as_of: 研究截止日（ISO 日期）。默认空 = 不设时点闸门
558        kb_scope: 本地知识库检索范围，由服务端按用户授权解析
559    """
560    dd_markers = ("尽职调查", "尽调", "贷前", "授信", "保理")
561    dd_mode = bool(due_diligence) if due_diligence is not None else bool(
562        subject_name or business_type or any(marker in query for marker in dd_markers)
563    )
564    frozen_profile = deepcopy(provided_company_profile or {})
565    frozen_ref = deepcopy(admin_profile_ref or {})
566    frozen_scenario = (admin_profile_scenario or "").strip()
567    try:
568        profile_bytes = json.dumps(
569            frozen_profile, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
570            separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False,
571        ).encode("utf-8")
572    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
573        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照必须是纯 JSON") from exc
574    managed_snapshot_requested = bool(frozen_profile) or bool(frozen_ref)
575    binding = (
576        create_admin_profile_snapshot_binding(
577            session_id, frozen_profile, frozen_ref, frozen_scenario
578        )
579        if managed_snapshot_requested else {}
580    )
581    return ResearchState(
582        query=query,
583        session_id=session_id,
584        phase=ResearchPhase.INIT.value,
585        iteration=0,
586        max_iterations=3,
587        search_web=search_web,
588        search_local=search_local,
589        kb_scope=list(kb_scope or []),
590        as_of=as_of,
591        subject_name=subject_name.strip(),
592        business_type=business_type.strip(),
593        due_diligence_mode=dd_mode,
594        # 不保留调用者对象引用。快照会进入检查点，后续外部档案更新不得影响
595        # 本次运行或已经开始的尽调。
596        provided_company_profile=frozen_profile,
597        admin_profile_ref=frozen_ref,
598        admin_profile_scenario=frozen_scenario,
599        admin_profile_payload_sha256=hashlib.sha256(profile_bytes).hexdigest() if frozen_profile else "",
600        admin_profile_snapshot_binding=binding,
601        checkpoint_graph_seal={},
602        company_name="",
603        credit_context="",
604        field_checks=[],
605        completeness={},
606        company_profile={},
607        scoring_view={},
608        evidence_store={},
609        rag_evidence_candidates=[],
610        rag_evidence_rejections=[],
611        rag_evidence_summary={},
612        risk_assessment={},
613        outline=[],
614        mind_map={},
615        key_entities=[],
616        research_questions=[],
617        hypotheses=[],  # 假设驱动研究
618        knowledge_graph={"nodes": [], "edges": []},  # 知识图谱
619        facts=[],
620        data_points=[],
621        raw_sources=[],
622        search_failures=[],
623        section_failures=[],
624        query_plan_shortfalls=[],
625        extraction_window_drops=[],
626        cross_channel_undecidable=[],
627        # 调查层默认随尽调模式开启（计划 9.1：生产默认开、可关闭）。
628        # **封闭评测必须显式传 False**——B 层是一次额外的模型调用，
629        # 留着它会给每轮评测加上不可复现的时间与费用，而评测只计 A 层的分。
630        cross_layer_verdict={},

644        pending_search_queries=[],
645        logs=[],
646        errors=[],
647        messages=[],
648        _checkpoint_integrity_mode=("managed_v1" if managed_snapshot_requested else "standard_v1"),
649    )

    118def create_admin_profile_snapshot_binding(
119    session_id: Any,
120    profile: Any,
121    ref: Any,
122    scenario: Any,
123) -> Dict[str, Any]:
124    """Create the HMAC envelope persisted with a managed-profile run."""
125    try:
126        ring = load_checkpoint_keyring()
127    except CheckpointKeyConfigurationError as exc:
128        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照密钥配置非法") from exc
129    if ring.explicit:
130        body = _admin_profile_snapshot_binding_v3_bytes(
131            session_id, profile, ref, scenario, ring.active_key_id,
132        )
133        return {
134            "version": _ADMIN_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_BINDING_V3,
135            "algorithm": "hmac-sha256",
136            "key_id": ring.active_key_id,
137            "mac": hmac.new(
138                _admin_profile_snapshot_v3_hmac_key(ring.active_key_id), body, hashlib.sha256
139            ).hexdigest(),
140        }
141    body = _admin_profile_snapshot_binding_bytes(session_id, profile, ref, scenario)
142    return {
143        "version": ADMIN_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_BINDING_VERSION,
144        "algorithm": "hmac-sha256",
145        "mac": hmac.new(_admin_profile_snapshot_hmac_key(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(),
146    }
147 
148 
149def verify_admin_profile_snapshot_binding(
150    binding: Any,
151    session_id: Any,
152    profile: Any,
153    ref: Any,
154    scenario: Any,
155) -> None:
156    """Fail closed unless the stored binding exactly covers this snapshot."""
157    if not isinstance(binding, dict):
158        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照绑定缺失或形状非法")
159    version = binding.get("version")
160    if type(version) is int and version == ADMIN_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_BINDING_VERSION:
161        if set(binding) != _ADMIN_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_BINDING_KEYS:
162            raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照绑定缺失或形状非法")
163        try:
164            ring = load_checkpoint_keyring()
165            legacy_id = ring.legacy_key_id
166            if not legacy_id:
167                raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照旧密钥不可用")
168            legacy_key = hmac.new(
169                ring.key_material(legacy_id), _ADMIN_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_HMAC_CONTEXT, hashlib.sha256,
170            ).digest()
171        except CheckpointKeyConfigurationError as exc:
172            raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照密钥配置非法") from exc
173        body = _admin_profile_snapshot_binding_bytes(session_id, profile, ref, scenario)
174        expected = hmac.new(legacy_key, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
175    elif type(version) is int and version == _ADMIN_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_BINDING_V3:
176        if set(binding) != _ADMIN_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_BINDING_V3_KEYS:
177            raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照绑定缺失或形状非法")
178        key_id = binding.get("key_id")
179        if not isinstance(key_id, str) or not key_id:
180            raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照绑定密钥标识非法")
181        body = _admin_profile_snapshot_binding_v3_bytes(session_id, profile, ref, scenario, key_id)
182        expected = hmac.new(_admin_profile_snapshot_v3_hmac_key(key_id), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
183    else:
184        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照绑定版本不受支持")
185    if binding.get("algorithm") != "hmac-sha256":
186        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照绑定算法非法")
187    supplied = binding.get("mac")
188    if (not isinstance(supplied, str) or len(supplied) != 64
189            or any(character not in "0123456789abcdef" for character in supplied)):
190        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照绑定 MAC 非法")
191    if not hmac.compare_digest(supplied, expected):
192        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照绑定不一致")

    54def validate_admin_company_profile_snapshot(
55    profile: Any,
56    ref: Any,
57    scenario: str = "",
58    payload_sha256: str = "",
59) -> Dict[str, Any]:
60    """Validate and detach a managed profile snapshot before it reaches state.
61 
62    An explicit admin-profile ID is a fail-closed path.  This function validates
63    the exact service reference and its service-bound decoration so a damaged
64    checkpoint cannot silently fall back to name matching or a newer profile.
65    The returned copy is marked only after hash validation; the marker permits
66    the narrowly-scoped ``_scenario_data`` projection in ``fill_field_checks``.
67    """
68    if not isinstance(profile, Mapping) or not isinstance(ref, Mapping):
69        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照必须包含 profile 与 ref 对象")
70    if set(ref) != _ADMIN_PROFILE_REF_KEYS:
71        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref 必须且只能包含 id/revision/content_sha256/source")
72 
73    profile_id = ref.get("id")
74    revision = ref.get("revision")
75    digest = ref.get("content_sha256")
76    if not isinstance(profile_id, str) or not profile_id.strip():
77        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref.id 非法")
78    if isinstance(revision, bool) or not isinstance(revision, (int, str)) or str(revision).strip() == "":
79        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref.revision 非法")
80    if not isinstance(digest, str) or len(digest) != 64 or any(ch not in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in digest):
81        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref.content_sha256 非法")
82    if ref.get("source") != "admin_company_profile":
83        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref.source 非法")
84 
85    try:
86        detached = json.loads(json.dumps(profile, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
87    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
88        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 profile 必须是纯 JSON") from exc
89    if payload_sha256:
90        if not isinstance(payload_sha256, str) or len(payload_sha256) != 64:
91            raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照哈希非法")
92        canonical = json.dumps(
93            detached, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False
94        ).encode("utf-8")
95        if hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest() != payload_sha256:
96            raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照 payload 已变化")
97    # ``content_sha256`` is the persisted-content digest.  The persistence
98    # service includes submitted materials in that digest but deliberately does
99    # not copy materials into the research snapshot.  Therefore it cannot be
100    # recomputed from this payload alone.  ``get_active_profile_snapshot``
101    # verifies it at the DB boundary; here we bind the payload to that verified
102    # ref again and fail closed if either decoration is absent or inconsistent.
103    embedded_ref = detached.get("_admin_profile_ref")
104    if not isinstance(embedded_ref, dict) or set(embedded_ref) != _ADMIN_PROFILE_REF_KEYS:
105        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案缺少受服务签发的 ref 装饰")
106    if embedded_ref != dict(ref):
107        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案内嵌 ref 与运行 ref 不一致")
108    if not isinstance(detached.get("_scenario_data"), dict):
109        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案缺少场景数据装饰")
110    if not isinstance(detached.get("_admin_field_sources"), list):
111        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案缺少字段来源装饰")
112    if not isinstance(scenario, str):
113        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案场景非法")
114    if not isinstance(detached.get("name"), str) or not detached["name"].strip():
115        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案缺少非空企业名称")
116    if "coverage" in detached and not isinstance(detached["coverage"], dict):
117        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 coverage 必须是对象")
118 
119    try:
120        from service.profile_schema import validate_profile
121    except ImportError:
122        from app.service.profile_schema import validate_profile
123    problems = validate_profile(detached)
124    if problems:
125        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案未通过结构校验：" + "；".join(problems))
126 
127    # This is an in-process capability, not a persisted profile field.  It is
128    # deliberately absent from the hash and can only be attached after the
129    # router has called the authorized profile service and this function has
130    # validated the returned ref.
131    detached["_admin_profile_snapshot_authorized"] = True
132    return detached
133

    511    def _restore_managed_profile_snapshot(
512        self,

519        """Re-authorize a managed snapshot before *any* restored execution.

521        The business and LangGraph checkpoint stores both contain plain JSON.
522        Consequently their nested authorization marker is not a capability on
523        its own: it is re-issued only after the HMAC-bound source snapshot,
524        evidence chain, and scoring view have all been reconstructed.

527        mode = integrity_mode or mode_from_state(state)

529            # There were no committed managed checkpoints before this format.
530            # A managed trace without the v1 graph seal is therefore damaged,
531            # not a legacy-static compatibility case.

542

547        if mode is None and not has_managed_trace:
548            # Explicit compatibility path for pre-integrity static checkpoints.
549            return state

589            from app.service.risk_scorecard import PROFILE_BACKED_FIELDS

600 
601        # Do not silently heal a persisted company profile.  A mismatch means
602        # an already-derived score/checklist might be tied to altered data.
603        if state.get("company_profile") != canonical_company:
604            raise ValueError("恢复态 company_profile 与经验证的管理端企业档案不一致")
605 
606        checks = state.get("field_checks")
607        evidence_store = state.get("evidence_store")
608        if not isinstance(checks, list) or not isinstance(evidence_store, dict):
609            raise ValueError("恢复的管理端企业档案缺少 field_checks 或 evidence_store")
610 
611        # Evidence replay validates asserted values, but by design it skips
612        # unverified checks.  Therefore it cannot notice that a checkpoint
613        # deleted an unverified required field, changed ``required`` to false,
614        # or downgraded a profile-backed assertion to unverified.  Rebuild the
615        # immutable checklist skeleton first and require an exact match.
616        resolved_scenario = resolve_scenario(
617            scenario,
618            state.get("business_type"),

620            (canonical_company.get("credit_application") or {}).get("product"),
621        )
622        expected_checks = build_field_checks(scenario=resolved_scenario)
623        immutable_keys = (
624            "field_id", "field_name", "category", "section_id", "scope", "required",
625        )
626        if len(checks) != len(expected_checks):
627            raise ValueError("恢复的管理端企业档案 field_checks 数量与固定清单不一致")
628        for current, expected in zip(checks, expected_checks):
629            if not isinstance(current, dict) or any(
630                current.get(key) != expected.get(key) for key in immutable_keys
631            ):
632                raise ValueError("恢复的管理端企业档案 field_checks 骨架与固定清单不一致")
633 
634        # This graph never creates exclusions: build_field_checks() above and
635        # the production load path both use exclude_ids=None.  Letting a saved
636        # required field change to ``not_applicable`` (or an unknown status)
637        # would remove it from the completeness denominator without evidence.
638        allowed_statuses = {"unverified", "verified", "conflicting"}
639        for current in checks:
640            status = current.get("status")
641            if status not in allowed_statuses:
642                raise ValueError(
643                    f"恢复的管理端企业档案字段 {current.get('field_id', '?')} "
644                    f"status 非法：{status!r}"
645                )
646            if status == "unverified" and (
647                current.get("verification_origin")
648                or current.get("evidence_ids")
649            ):
650                raise ValueError(
651                    f"恢复的管理端企业档案字段 {current.get('field_id', '?')} "
652                    "已降级为 unverified 但仍携带核实来源"
653                )
654 
655        # A profile-backed assertion may not disappear during persistence.
656        # Structured adapters only supplement fields that were unverified;
657        # replacing an initial-profile assertion is a separate, explicit
658        # supersession workflow and is not authorized by checkpoint restore.
659        profile_replay = replay_from_profile(canonical_company, checks)
660        by_field = {check.get("field_id"): check for check in checks}
661        for field_id, expected in profile_replay.items():
662            if expected.get("status") not in {"verified", "conflicting"}:
663                continue
664            current = by_field.get(field_id) or {}
665            if (
666                current.get("status") != expected.get("status")
667                or current.get("value") != expected.get("value")
668                or current.get("verification_origin") != "initial_profile"
669            ):
670                raise ValueError(
671                    f"恢复的管理端企业档案字段 {field_id} 丢失初始档案断言"
672                )
673 
674        replay = verify_field_checks(
675            canonical_company, checks, evidence_store,
676            as_of=state.get("as_of", "") or "",
677        )
678        if replay.mismatches:
679            fields = "、".join(
680                f"{item.get('field_id', '?')}({item.get('reason', 'unknown')})"
681                for item in replay.mismatches
682            )
683            raise ValueError(f"恢复的管理端企业档案证据链重放失败：{fields}")
684 
685        # verify_field_checks is intentionally directional (check -> evidence).
686        # Restore also needs the reverse invariant: every active structured
687        # evidence record must still be the current assertion of exactly one
688        # check.  Otherwise a checkpoint can downgrade an adverse adapter
689        # result to unverified while leaving its evidence silently orphaned.
690        active_evidence: Dict[str, str] = {}
691        for evidence_id, evidence in evidence_store.items():
692            if (
693                not isinstance(evidence_id, str)
694                or not isinstance(evidence, dict)
695                or evidence.get("evidence_id") != evidence_id
696            ):
697                raise ValueError("恢复的管理端企业档案 evidence_store 形状非法")
698            if evidence.get("active") is not False and not evidence.get("superseded_by"):
699                active_evidence[evidence_id] = str(evidence.get("field_id") or "")
700 
701        referenced_evidence: Dict[str, str] = {}
702        for current in checks:
703            if current.get("verification_origin") != "structured_adapter":
704                continue
705            field_id = str(current.get("field_id") or "")
706            for evidence_id in current.get("evidence_ids") or []:
707                if not isinstance(evidence_id, str) or evidence_id in referenced_evidence:
708                    raise ValueError("恢复的管理端企业档案存在重复或非法 evidence_id")
709                referenced_evidence[evidence_id] = field_id
710        if referenced_evidence != active_evidence:
711            raise ValueError("恢复的管理端企业档案存在孤立或未引用的活动证据")
712 
713        rebuilt_completeness = compute_completeness(checks)
714        if state.get("completeness") != rebuilt_completeness:
715            raise ValueError("恢复态 completeness 与经验证的固定清单不一致")
716        state["completeness"] = rebuilt_completeness
717 
718        scoring_view = state.get("scoring_view")
719        if scoring_view:
720            if not isinstance(scoring_view, dict):
721                raise ValueError("恢复的管理端企业档案 scoring_view 非法")
722            rebuilt_view, unmergeable = build_scoring_view(
723                canonical_company,
724                checks,
725                evidence_store,
726                profile_backed_fields=PROFILE_BACKED_FIELDS,
727                profile_replay_fn=replay_from_profile,
728            )
729            if unmergeable:
730                fields = "、".join(str(item.get("field_id", "?")) for item in unmergeable)
731                raise ValueError(f"恢复的管理端企业档案评分视图无法重建：{fields}")
732            if scoring_view != rebuilt_view:
733                raise ValueError("恢复态 scoring_view 与经验证的管理端企业档案不一致")
734            state["scoring_view"] = rebuilt_view
735 
736        # validate_admin_company_profile_snapshot returns a fresh copy and is
737        # the only place that issues this in-process authorization marker.
738        state["company_profile"] = canonical_company
739        return state

391        """保存检查点（包含后端状态和 UI 状态）"""

    223class FieldCheck(TypedDict):
224    """
225    核查项运行时状态（清单定义见 config/dd_checklist.py）
226 
227    这是反幻觉设计的地基：把"查没查到"从散落在正文里的措辞，
228    变成显式、可计数、下游可消费的结构化数据。
229 
230    status 语义（务必区分，写错会误导授信决策）：
231        verified       已核实，有值且可溯源到 sources 中的 fact
232        unverified     尝试过但未取到。**不等于"不存在"**
233        conflicting    多源数据不一致，本身即风险信号（v0.4 多源接入后才可能出现）
234        not_applicable 该项对此类主体无意义（如个体工商户无股权结构）
235    """
236    field_id: str
237    field_name: str
238    category: str
239    section_id: str
240    required: bool
241    status: str                      # verified|unverified|conflicting|not_applicable
242    value: Any                       # verified 时的值，其余为 None
243    sources: List[str]               # fact_id 列表，指向 facts 中的取证记录
244    attempted_sources: List[str]     # 尝试过的数据源标识
245    failure_reason: str              # unverified 时必填
246    conflict_detail: List[Dict[str, Any]]  # conflicting 时填 [{source, value}]
247    checked_at: str
248 
249    # —— 溯源字段（v0.6）。verified / conflicting 必须齐备，否则 fail-closed ——
250    # 见 service/verification.py。设为可选是为了兼容旧检查点：
251    # 缺失时走显式降级路径，而不是被当成合法来源静默通过。
252    verification_origin: str         # initial_profile | structured_adapter
253    evidence_ids: List[str]          # 指向 evidence_store，structured_adapter 必填
254    source_adapter: str              # 产出该结论的适配器标识
255    # initial_profile 的管理员快照会记录字段级来源链；静态/旧档案可缺该字段，
256    # 继续按其历史 retrieved_at 重放。每项仅包含覆盖该 field_id 的来源，且
257    # 保留 source_id/name/issuer/source_type/retrieved_at/as_of_date/reference/sha256。
258    profile_sources: List[Dict[str, Any]]
259    retrieved_at: str                # 字段来源中最新的取证时间；静态旧档案按原逻辑
260    as_of_date: str                  # 字段来源中最新的事实日期；研究截止日优先使用它
261 
262

    822def search_profile_materials(

825) -> Dict[str, Any]:
826    """Deterministic, scoreless lexical retrieval over only this profile's materials."""

844            })

    21class ChecklistItem:
22    """核查项定义（静态元数据，不含运行时状态）"""
23    field_id: str
24    field_name: str
25    category: str          # basic|equity|financial|judicial|relation|operation|opinion
26    section_id: str        # 归属的报告章节
27    required: bool         # 必查项未核实会触发风险等级下限（v0.5 完整度闸门）
28    description: str       # 供 Writer 理解该项要交代什么
29    primary_source: str    # 主数据源，未取到时写入 attempted_sources
30    data_source_status: str = "available"
31    """
32    该项**是否存在可用的获取路径**（BC-18）。
33 
34    available       —— 有数据源。查不到属于「信息缺口」：可能是数据源故障、
35                       主体存疑，重试或换源有可能解决。
36    not_implemented —— 系统尚不具备核查该项的能力，重试永远不会成功。
37 
38    ## 为什么必须区分，以及区分之后**不能**做什么
39 
40    区分的目的**不是**把能力缺失从风险中排除——借款人的担保圈敞口是未知的，
41    不管未知的原因是什么。因为"我们查不了"就不计入风险，正是完整度闸门
42    当初要防的那件事（查不到 ≠ 没问题）。
43 
44    区分的目的是让**闸门理由准确**。此前能力缺失伪装成「维度核实率不足」，
45    导致每份报告都挂同一条闸门——一个永远亮的告警等于没有告警，
46    风控人员会学会无视它，真正的信息缺口反而被淹没。
47 
48    因此 `not_implemented` 的项：
49      - 仍然计入 `verified_rate` 的分母（诚实：15 项必查确实只核实了 14 项）
50      - **不**计入维度核实率的分母（它不是这次没查到，不该拖累同维度其它项）
51      - 触发一条**专用闸门**，明确写出是能力缺失、须线下人工核查
52    """
53    absence_meaningful: bool = True
54    """
55    数据源查询后返回空结果时，「无记录」是否构成有效结论。
56 
57    True  —— 事件型字段（涉诉、失信、对外担保、舆情…）。
58             这类事件可以合法地不存在，查询返回空 = 已核实的正面结论。
59 
60    False —— 属性型字段（工商登记、股东结构、营业收入…）。
61             一个存续经营的企业必然具备这些属性。查询返回空不是"没有"，
62             而是**异常信号**：主体可能不存在、已注销，或数据源故障。
63             绝不能表述为"经查询无相关记录"——那会把 critical 风险
64             粉饰成中性结论。
65    """
66 
67 
68#: 事件型字段查询后返回空结果时写入的取值。
69#:
70#: **这是一个已核实的正面结论**，不是信息缺口——`absence_meaningful=True`
71#: 的字段（涉诉、失信、对外担保、舆情…）可以合法地不存在，

    410def compute_completeness(field_checks: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
411    """
412    统计核实情况。
413 
414    注意：not_applicable 不计入分母——该项对此主体本就无意义，
415    不该拉低核实率，否则会误导对信息充分性的判断。
416 
417    ⚠️ 除 `scenario` 一块之外的**全部指标只统计核心二十项**（BC-58）。
418    场景扩展项若混进 `by_category`，会静默移动一套已经标定并测试过的闸门
419    阈值——加字段本该是加法，不该顺手改判据。
420    """
421    scenario_checks = [c for c in field_checks if not is_core_check(c)]
422    field_checks = [c for c in field_checks if is_core_check(c)]
423    required = [c for c in field_checks if c.get("required") and c.get("status") != "not_applicable"]
424    verified = [c for c in required if c.get("status") == "verified"]
425    unverified = [c for c in required if c.get("status") == "unverified"]
426    conflicting = [c for c in field_checks if c.get("status") == "conflicting"]
427 
428    # 能力缺失项（BC-18）：系统根本查不了，重试永远不会成功。
429    # 它们**仍计入 verified_rate 的分母**——15 项必查确实只核实了 14 项，
430    # 这个数字必须诚实。但不计入维度核实率的分母：把"永远查不了"和
431    # "这次没查到"混在一个比率里，会让同维度其它项被无辜拖累，
432    # 且闸门理由永远指向错误的方向。
433    capability_gaps = [
434        c["field_id"] for c in field_checks
435        if c.get("field_id") in CAPABILITY_GAP_IDS
436        and c.get("status") not in ("verified", "not_applicable")
437    ]
438 
439    by_category: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
440    for c in field_checks:
441        if c.get("status") == "not_applicable":
442            continue
443        cat = c.get("category", "?")
444        stat = by_category.setdefault(cat, {"total": 0, "verified": 0, "capability_gaps": 0})
445        if c.get("field_id") in capability_gaps:
446            stat["capability_gaps"] += 1
447            continue                      # 不进该维度的分子分母
448        stat["total"] += 1
449        if c.get("status") == "verified":
450            stat["verified"] += 1
451    for stat in by_category.values():
452        stat["rate"] = round(stat["verified"] / stat["total"], 3) if stat["total"] else 0.0
453 
454    # 场景扩展覆盖率单独成块。评分器与报告分别呈现"核心主体清单覆盖率"和
455    # "场景决策清单覆盖率"——两个数字回答的是不同问题：前者问主体查清了吗，
456    # 后者问这笔业务的决策变量齐了吗。合成一个数会同时失去两个意义。
457    scenario_applicable = [c for c in scenario_checks if c.get("status") != "not_applicable"]
458    scenario_verified = [c for c in scenario_applicable if c.get("status") == "verified"]
459    scenario_name = next(
460        (str(c.get("scope") or "").split(":", 1)[1]
461         for c in scenario_checks if str(c.get("scope") or "").startswith("scenario:")),
462        "",
463    )
464 
465    return {
466        "required_total": len(required),
467        "required_verified": len(verified),
468        "verified_rate": round(len(verified) / len(required), 3) if required else 0.0,
469        "unverified_fields": [c["field_id"] for c in unverified],
470        "conflicting_fields": [c["field_id"] for c in conflicting],
471        # 与 unverified_fields 有交集，但语义不同：前者是信息缺口（可补），
472        # 这里是能力缺失（补不了，须线下核查）。消费方必须分开呈现。
473        "capability_gaps": capability_gaps,
474        "by_category": by_category,
475        "scenario": {
476            "name": scenario_name,
477            "total": len(scenario_applicable),
478            "verified": len(scenario_verified),
479            "rate": round(len(scenario_verified) / len(scenario_applicable), 3)
480                    if scenario_applicable else 0.0,
481            "unverified_fields": [c["field_id"] for c in scenario_applicable
482                                  if c.get("status") != "verified"],
483        },
484    }
485

    只解码失败的复核 SSE 请求 frontend/src/api/duediligence.ts:305

    提交 f5f8d17 · 以下是第 305–331 行的局部源码，不是整个文件。源码注释可能包含历史描述，应结合本章核对。

    305export async function submitReview(
306  sessionId: string,
307  decision: ReviewDecision,
308  options?: AxiosRequestConfig,
309) {
310  try {
311    return await request.post<ReadableStream<Uint8Array>>(`/research/review/${sessionId}`, decision, {
312      headers: { Accept: 'text/event-stream' },
313      responseType: 'stream',
314      adapter: 'fetch',
315      loading: false,
316      errorToast: false,
317      ...options,
318    })
319  } catch (error) {
320    // fetch + responseType: stream also wraps pre-SSE JSON errors in a stream.
321    // Decode only the failed response; leave the successful event stream intact.
322    if (isAxiosError(error) && error.response?.data instanceof ReadableStream) {
323      try {
324        const data: unknown = await new Response(error.response.data).json()
325        if (data && typeof data === 'object') error.response.data = data
326      } catch {
327        // A proxy may return non-JSON errors; retain the original HTTP status.
328      }
329    }
330    throw error
331  }

210def _assert_review_target(info: Dict[str, Any], current_user: User) -> str:
211    """Require an owned checkpoint and separation between owner and reviewer.
212 
213    A reviewer capability grants no generic checkpoint access.  It only permits
214    a non-owner to submit a decision for an existing, owned review target.
215    Legacy checkpoints without an owner cannot prove this separation, so they
216    are deliberately rejected rather than becoming reviewable by everyone.
217    """
218    owner_id = info.get("user_id")
219    if not owner_id:
220        raise HTTPException(
221            status_code=HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
222            detail="无归属研究会话不能提交人工复核",
223        )
224    if str(owner_id) == str(current_user.id):
225        raise HTTPException(
226            status_code=HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
227            detail="研究发起人不得审核自己的会话",
228        )
229    return str(owner_id)
230

    174def _resolve_scope(
175    db: Session,
176    current_user: User,

178    search_local: bool,
179) -> list:
180    """
181    解析本次研究可检索的本地知识库。
182 
183    未启用本地检索时返回空列表——不去查库，也不会因此产生检索故障
184    （Scout 只在 `search_local=True` 时走本地路径）。
185 
186    ⚠️ 范围永远按**登录用户**解析，不接受客户端传集合名。
187    超级用户在这里也不放宽：检查点复核需要跨用户可见性，
188    而把别人上传的财报召回进自己的尽调报告是另一回事。
189    """
190    if not search_local:
191        return []
192    scope = resolve_kb_scope(db, str(current_user.id), kb_name)
193    if not scope.entries:
194        # 不在这里抛错：启用了本地检索却没有知识库是常见情形，
195        # 应当由 Scout 记为检索故障并写进报告，而不是让整个研究请求失败。
196        logger.warning(f"[research] 本地检索范围为空：{scope.failure_reason}")
197    return scope.as_state()

63    the exact service reference and its service-bound decoration so a damaged
64    checkpoint cannot silently fall back to name matching or a newer profile.
65    The returned copy is marked only after hash validation; the marker permits
66    the narrowly-scoped ``_scenario_data`` projection in ``fill_field_checks``.
67    """
68    if not isinstance(profile, Mapping) or not isinstance(ref, Mapping):
69        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案快照必须包含 profile 与 ref 对象")
70    if set(ref) != _ADMIN_PROFILE_REF_KEYS:
71        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref 必须且只能包含 id/revision/content_sha256/source")
72 
73    profile_id = ref.get("id")
74    revision = ref.get("revision")
75    digest = ref.get("content_sha256")
76    if not isinstance(profile_id, str) or not profile_id.strip():
77        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref.id 非法")
78    if isinstance(revision, bool) or not isinstance(revision, (int, str)) or str(revision).strip() == "":
79        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref.revision 非法")
80    if not isinstance(digest, str) or len(digest) != 64 or any(ch not in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in digest):
81        raise ValueError("管理端企业档案 ref.content_sha256 非法")

71class DataSourceAdapter(ABC):

79    `structured_adapter` 身份**。通用网页检索与 LLM 抽取永远不得登记：
80    它们产出自然语言，无法在重放时做字段级等值比对（v0.6a 规则 2）。

84    description: str = ""

90            raise ValueError(f"{type(self).__name__} 必须声明 adapter_id 与 covers")

106        由 `apply()` 按字段类型决定它是正面结论还是异常信号。

    提交 f5f8d17 · 以下是第 127–199 行的局部源码，不是整个文件。源码注释可能包含历史描述，应结合本章核对。

    127    def apply(
128        self,
129        company: Dict[str, Any],
130        field_checks: List[Dict[str, Any]],
131        evidence_store: Dict[str, Dict],
132    ) -> Dict[str, str]:
133        """
134        对清单施加本适配器的核查结论。
135 
136        ⚠️ 只处理 `covers` 内、且**当前尚未核实**的字段。
137        已由初始档案核实的项不覆盖——覆盖需要显式的证据替代授权（BC-40），
138        而"我后跑"不构成替代理由。
139 
140        Returns: {field_id: 处理结果说明}，供调用方记录与断言。
141        """
142        try:
143            from config.dd_checklist import CHECKLIST_BY_ID, NO_RECORD_VALUE
144        except ImportError:
145            from app.config.dd_checklist import CHECKLIST_BY_ID, NO_RECORD_VALUE
146 
147        result = self.fetch(company)
148        outcome: Dict[str, str] = {}
149        if result is None:
150            # 查不到主体本身是信息，但不是"无记录"——不动任何字段状态
151            for fid in sorted(self.covers):
152                outcome[fid] = "adapter_no_subject"
153            return outcome
154 
155        by_id = {c["field_id"]: c for c in field_checks}
156        for fid in sorted(self.covers):
157            chk = by_id.get(fid)
158            if chk is None or chk.get("status") in ("verified", "conflicting",
159                                                    "not_applicable"):
160                outcome[fid] = "skipped_already_settled"
161                continue
162            if fid not in result.queried:
163                # 该源没查这一项：保持信息缺口，写明原因，绝不当作"无记录"
164                chk["failure_reason"] = result.not_queried_reason.get(
165                    fid, f"数据源 {self.adapter_id} 未覆盖该项")
166                self._note_attempt(chk)
167                outcome[fid] = "not_queried"
168                continue
169 
170            value = self.extract(fid, result.raw)
171            item = CHECKLIST_BY_ID.get(fid)
172            if value is None:
173                if item is not None and not item.absence_meaningful:
174                    # 属性型字段返回空 = 主体存疑，绝不能粉饰成"经查询无记录"
175                    chk["failure_reason"] = (
176                        f"数据源 {self.adapter_id} 已查询但未返回该项内容。"
177                        f"此为必备属性，缺失属异常信号，须人工核实主体真实性")
178                    self._note_attempt(chk)
179                    outcome[fid] = "attribute_missing_anomaly"
180                    continue
181                value = NO_RECORD_VALUE
182 
183            record_structured_evidence(
184                evidence_store, chk,
185                source_adapter=self.adapter_id,
186                status="verified",
187                value=value,
188                raw=result.raw,
189                retrieved_at=result.retrieved_at,
190            )
191            self._note_attempt(chk)
192            outcome[fid] = "verified"
193        return outcome
194 
195    def _note_attempt(self, chk: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
196        attempted = chk.setdefault("attempted_sources", [])
197        if self.adapter_id not in attempted:
198            attempted.append(self.adapter_id)

81        if field_id == "guarantee":

90    @staticmethod
91    def project_profile_patch(field_id: str, raw: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
92        """

94        取笔数与金额算 relation 维度。

96        `related_party` / `external_investment` 不在 `PROFILE_BACKED_FIELDS` 里，
97        评分卡不从档案取它们的值，因此返回 None：**不该进评分的数据就不要
98        塞进评分视图**，patch 越权是 BC-36。
99        """
100        if field_id != "guarantee":
101            return None
102        # ⚠️ 无担保记录时**必须**返回空列表 patch，不能返回 None。
103        #
104        # 起初我按"合并空列表不改变任何结论"的理由返回了 None，实测直接
105        # 触发 `evidence_not_mergeable`：`guarantee` 属 PROFILE_BACKED_FIELDS，
106        # 一条没有 patch 的证据会让整份评级 fail-closed（BC-31 的保护）。
107        #
108        # 想错的地方在于：patch 的作用不只是"改变数据"，更是**声明这条证据
109        # 能被评分卡消费**。「查了，无担保」本身就是一条要进评分视图的结论。
110        # 合并语义是追加，空列表也不会抹掉档案里已有的记录。
111        return {"guarantee": [dict(g) for g in (raw.get("guarantee") or [])]}

    83def register_adapter(
84    adapter_id: str,
85    description: str,
86    *,
87    project_profile_patch: Optional[Callable[[str, Dict[str, Any]], Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None,
88) -> None:
89    """
90    登记一个受信任的结构化数据源适配器。
91 
92    只有真正返回**结构化字段**、且能在重放时做等值比对的数据源才可登记。
93    会影响评分档案的适配器必须同时登记 `project_profile_patch` 纯函数，
94    由它从 raw 确定性生成 patch；调用方不能自由决定进入评分的数据。
95    通用网页检索、LLM 抽取一律不得登记——它们产出的是自然语言。
96    """
97    if not adapter_id or not isinstance(adapter_id, str):
98        raise ValueError("adapter_id 必须是非空字符串")
99    _TRUSTED_ADAPTERS[adapter_id] = {
100        "description": description,
101        "project_profile_patch": project_profile_patch,
102    }
103 
104 
105def unregister_adapter(adapter_id: str) -> None:
106    """仅供测试隔离使用。"""
107    _TRUSTED_ADAPTERS.pop(adapter_id, None)
108 
109 
110def is_trusted_adapter(adapter_id: str) -> bool:
111    return adapter_id in _TRUSTED_ADAPTERS
112 
113 
114def trusted_adapters() -> Dict[str, str]:
115    return {k: v["description"] for k, v in _TRUSTED_ADAPTERS.items()}
116 
117 
118def _project_registered_patch(
119    adapter_id: str,
120    field_id: str,
121    raw: Dict[str, Any],
122) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
123    projector = (_TRUSTED_ADAPTERS.get(adapter_id) or {}).get("project_profile_patch")
124    if projector is None:
125        return None
126    projected = projector(field_id, deepcopy(raw))
127    if projected is not None and not isinstance(projected, dict):
128        raise ValueError("适配器 profile patch 投影器必须返回 dict 或 None")
129    return projected

408    要求 5：适配器不得只改 `field_checks` 的状态，必须同步落一条结构化证据。
409    本函数一次性写完 evidence_store 与 field_check 的
410    status / value / conflict_detail / verification_origin / evidence_ids /
411    source_adapter / retrieved_at ——**调用方不需要、也不应该自己动这些字段**。
412 
413    ⚠️ 这一点在 v0.6a 首版是假的：当时函数只写来源字段，状态和取值仍要调用方
414    自己改，两步之间存在漂移窗口，而文档却宣称"绑定后那条路径走不通"。
415    该缺陷记为 BC-34，本函数是修复后的版本。
416 
417    非法组合直接抛 `ValueError`：适配器传错参数是编程错误，应当当场炸掉，
418    而不是写进证据库等重放时才发现。
419 
420    `profile_patch` 参数仅作为迁移期的可选一致性断言：若传入，必须等于注册
421    投影器从 raw 生成的结果；真正写入 evidence_store 的始终是投影器产物。
422 
423    字段已有当前证据时，调用方还必须明确提交完整的
424    `supersedes_evidence_ids` 与非空 `supersede_reason`；调用顺序不自动代表
425    版本替代，避免把多来源冲突静默覆盖成单一结论（BC-40）。
426    """
427    if not is_trusted_adapter(source_adapter):
428        raise ValueError(
429            f"适配器 {source_adapter!r} 未注册。只有登记在案的结构化数据源才能"
430            f"产出 structured_adapter 身份；通用网页检索/LLM 抽取不得登记。"
431            f"当前已注册：{sorted(_TRUSTED_ADAPTERS)}"
432        )
433    if status not in EVIDENCE_REQUIRED_STATUSES:
434        raise ValueError(
435            f"status 必须是 {sorted(EVIDENCE_REQUIRED_STATUSES)} 之一，收到 {status!r}。"
436            f"unverified / not_applicable 不主张事实，不得经由证据写入口产生"
437        )
438    if not raw:
439        raise ValueError("raw 不得为空：适配器原始返回是人工追溯的唯一依据")
440    cur = _timestamp_key(retrieved_at)
441    if cur is None:
442        raise ValueError(f"retrieved_at {retrieved_at!r} 不是合法 ISO 时间")
443    # as_of_date 可以缺（旧适配器还没声明），但给了就必须合法——
444    # 一个解析不出来的日期比没有更危险：它看起来像已经声明过了。
445    if as_of_date and _timestamp_key(as_of_date) is None:
446        raise ValueError(
447            f"as_of_date {as_of_date!r} 不是合法 ISO 日期。该字段表示证据所述事实的"
448            f"发布/事件日期，与 retrieved_at（何时取到）不是一回事"
449        )
450 
451    field_id = field_check.get("field_id")
452    if not field_id:
453        raise ValueError("field_check 缺少 field_id")
454    projected_patch = _project_registered_patch(source_adapter, field_id, raw)
455    if projected_patch is not None:
456        if profile_patch is not None and profile_patch != projected_patch:
457            raise ValueError(
458                "调用方提交的 profile_patch 与受信任适配器从 raw 确定性投影的结果不一致"
459            )
460        profile_patch = projected_patch
461    elif profile_patch:
462        raise ValueError(
463            f"适配器 {source_adapter!r} 未登记 profile patch 投影器；"
464            "调用方不得自由决定进入评分的数据"
465        )
466    _validate_profile_patch_shape(field_id, profile_patch)
467 
468    if status == STATUS_VERIFIED:
469        if value in (None, ""):
470            raise ValueError("verified 必须给出非空 value")
471        if conflict_values:
472            raise ValueError("verified 不得同时携带 conflict_values；有分歧就应标 conflicting")
473    else:  # conflicting
474        entries = conflict_values or []
475        if value not in (None, ""):
476            raise ValueError("conflicting 不得携带单一 value——那等于替复核人做了采信判断")
477        sources, values = _distinct_conflict_pairs(entries)
478        if len(sources) < 2 or len(values) < 2:
479            raise ValueError(
480                f"conflicting 需要至少两个不同来源的两个不同取值，"
481                f"实际来源 {len(sources)} 个、取值 {len(values)} 个。"
482                f"同源同值凑不出分歧"
483            )
484 
485    # 先完成所有可能失败的计算，再一次性提交两个共享对象。此前 naive/aware
486    # 时间比较会在写入一半后抛错，留下无法重放的半状态（BC-37）。
487    previous_ids = list(field_check.get("evidence_ids") or [])
488    declared_supersedes = list(supersedes_evidence_ids or [])
489    if previous_ids:
490        if set(declared_supersedes) != set(previous_ids):
491            raise ValueError(
492                "字段已有当前证据；更新结论时必须通过 supersedes_evidence_ids "
493                "明确声明要替代的完整证据集合"
494            )
495        if not supersede_reason.strip():
496            raise ValueError("替代已有证据时必须提供非空 supersede_reason，保留审计原因")
497    elif declared_supersedes:
498        raise ValueError("字段没有当前证据，不得声明 supersedes_evidence_ids")
499 
500    previous_times = []
501    for eid in previous_ids:
502        old = evidence_store.get(eid)
503        if old is None:
504            raise ValueError(f"当前证据 {eid!r} 不存在，不得通过新写入静默修复断链")
505        if old.get("field_id") != field_id:
506            raise ValueError(f"当前证据 {eid!r} 属于其他字段，不得通过新写入静默改写")
507        if old.get("active") is False or old.get("superseded_by"):
508            raise ValueError(f"当前证据 {eid!r} 已失效，不得再次作为被替代版本")
509        old_ts = _timestamp_key(old.get("retrieved_at"))
510        if old_ts is None:
511            raise ValueError(f"当前证据 {eid!r} 缺少合法时间，不得通过新写入掩盖")
512        previous_times.append((old_ts, eid))
513    newest_previous = max((ts for ts, _ in previous_times), default=None)
514    if newest_previous is not None and cur < newest_previous:
515        raise ValueError(
516            f"retrieved_at {retrieved_at!r} 早于当前有效证据时间，"
517            "不得用旧数据覆盖新结论"
518        )
519 
520    ev_id = new_evidence_id(field_id)
521    new_evidence = {
522        "evidence_id": ev_id,
523        "field_id": field_id,
524        "source_adapter": source_adapter,
525        "retrieved_at": retrieved_at,
526        "as_of_date": as_of_date,
527        "value": value,
528        "conflict_values": list(conflict_values or []),
529        "profile_patch": deepcopy(profile_patch) if profile_patch else {},
530        "raw": deepcopy(raw),
531        "active": True,
532        "supersedes": previous_ids,
533        "supersede_reason": supersede_reason.strip(),
534    }
535    new_check = deepcopy(field_check)
536    new_check["status"] = status
537    new_check["verification_origin"] = ORIGIN_STRUCTURED_ADAPTER
538    new_check["source_adapter"] = source_adapter
539    new_check["failure_reason"] = failure_reason
540    # evidence_ids 是“当前结论使用的证据”，不是无界历史列表。历史仍保留在
541    # evidence_store，并以 active/superseded_by 显式标记（BC-38）。
542    new_check["evidence_ids"] = [ev_id]
543    if status == STATUS_VERIFIED:
544        new_check["value"] = value
545        new_check["conflict_detail"] = []
546    else:
547        new_check["value"] = None
548        new_check["conflict_detail"] = [
549            {"source": e.get("source"), "value": e.get("value"),
550             "retrieved_at": e.get("retrieved_at", retrieved_at)}
551            for e in (conflict_values or [])
552        ]
553    new_check["retrieved_at"] = retrieved_at
554    # 事实/发布日期与取证时间语义不同，二者都要随当前结论进入清单。
555    # Writer 引用事实日期，审计附录仍保留何时抓取；不得用运行日冒充发布日期。
556    new_check["as_of_date"] = as_of_date
557 
558    for old_id in previous_ids:
559        old = evidence_store.get(old_id)
560        if old is not None:
561            old["active"] = False
562            old["superseded_by"] = ev_id
563    evidence_store[ev_id] = new_evidence
564    field_check.clear()
565    field_check.update(new_check)
566    return ev_id
567

    提交 f5f8d17 · 以下是第 193–239 行的局部源码，不是整个文件。源码注释可能包含历史描述，应结合本章核对。

    193def _resolve_oracle_path(case_root: str | Path) -> Path:
194    root = Path(case_root).resolve(strict=True)
195    if not root.is_dir():
196        raise OracleLoadError(f"case root is not a directory: {root}")
197    oracle_directory = root / "oracle"
198    if oracle_directory.is_symlink() or not oracle_directory.is_dir():
199        raise OracleLoadError("oracle/ must be a real directory inside the case package")
200    oracle_root = oracle_directory.resolve(strict=True)
201    if not oracle_root.is_relative_to(root):
202        raise OracleLoadError("oracle/ resolves outside the case package")
203    expected = oracle_directory / "expected.json"
204    if expected.is_symlink() or not expected.is_file():
205        raise OracleLoadError("oracle/expected.json must be a regular file")
206    resolved = expected.resolve(strict=True)
207    if not resolved.is_relative_to(root) or not resolved.is_relative_to(oracle_root):
208        raise OracleLoadError("oracle/expected.json resolves outside oracle/")
209    return resolved
210 
211 
212def load_due_diligence_oracle(
213    case_root: str | Path, production_case: DueDiligenceCase
214) -> DueDiligenceOracle:
215    """Load fixed ``oracle/expected.json`` and match it to an explicit case."""
216 
217    if not isinstance(production_case, DueDiligenceCase):
218        raise TypeError("production_case must be a loaded DueDiligenceCase")
219    path = _resolve_oracle_path(case_root)
220    try:
221        oracle = DueDiligenceOracle.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
222    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
223        raise OracleLoadError(f"oracle file is not UTF-8: {path}") from exc
224    except ValidationError as exc:
225        raise OracleLoadError(f"invalid oracle expected.json: {exc}") from exc
226    oracle.validate_against_case(production_case)
227    return oracle

270@router.delete("/{kb_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
271async def delete_knowledge_base(
272    kb_id: str,
273    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user_required),
274    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
275):
276    """删除知识库"""
277    try:
278        kb_uuid = UUID(kb_id)
279    except ValueError:
280        raise HTTPException(
281            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
282            detail="无效的知识库ID格式"
283        )
284 
285    kb = db.query(KnowledgeBase).filter(
286        KnowledgeBase.id == kb_uuid,
287        KnowledgeBase.user_id == current_user.id
288    ).first()
289 
290    if not kb:
291        raise HTTPException(
292            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
293            detail="知识库不存在"
294        )
295 
296    # 先删向量再删记录：反过来的话，删库成功而删集合失败会留下一个
297    # 谁都不知道其存在的孤儿集合——没有 kb 记录就再也定位不到它。
298    #
299    # 此前这里**完全不碰 Milvus**。在旧的按名命名方案下，这不只是
300    # 存储泄漏：删掉「财报」再建一个「财报」，旧向量会原样复活到新知识库里。
301    # 改用 UUID 后复活问题自动消失（UUID 不复用），但孤儿存储仍需清理。
302    collection_name = collection_name_for(kb.id)
303    try:
304        get_milvus_service().delete_collection(collection_name)
305    except Exception as e:
306        # 向量删不掉不应阻止用户删知识库，但必须留下可追查的记录
307        print(f"[delete_knowledge_base] 集合 {collection_name} 清理失败: {e}")
308 
309    db.delete(kb)
310    db.commit()
311    return None
312

376

379

381    db.refresh(doc)
382 
383    # 获取数据库会话工厂

392        SessionLocal
393    )
394 
395    return DocumentUploadResponse(

    248def process_document_with_docmind(
249    file_path: str,
250    file_name: str,
251    index_name: str,
252    chunk_size: int = 500,
253    kb_id: str = "",
254    document_id: str = "",
255) -> Dict[str, Any]:
256    """
257    使用 DocMind 处理文档
258 
259    Args:
260        file_path: 文件路径
261        file_name: 文件名
262        index_name: Milvus 集合名（`kb_<知识库UUID>`，由 kb_scope 生成）
263        chunk_size: 切片大小
264        kb_id: 知识库 UUID。写进每条切片的 `kb_id` 字段
265        document_id: 文档 UUID。写进每条切片的 `doc_id` 字段
266 
267    Returns:
268        处理结果
269 
270    ## kb_id / document_id 为什么是必填（BC-53）
271 
272    这两个参数以前不存在，切片里写的是：
273 
274        "kb_id":  index_name              # 集合名本身，过滤时形同虚设
275        "doc_id": md5(file_name)          # 只由文件名决定
276 
277    后果一：`kb_id` 过滤没有任何隔离作用（在集合 X 里筛 `kb_id == X`）。
278    后果二更严重——切片主键 `id = md5(f"{file_name}_{i}_{chunk[:50]}")`
279    同样只由文件名和内容决定。**两个用户上传同名同内容的文件，
280    会生成完全相同的主键**，在共用集合里互相覆盖。
281 
282    改为数据库主键之后，两者都是全局唯一且不可变的。
283    """
284    result = {
285        "success": False,
286        "message": "",
287        "document_count": 0,
288    }
289 
290    try:
291        print(f"开始处理文档: {file_name}")
292 
293        # 1. 初始化服务并提交任务
294        service = DocMindService()
295        task_id = service.submit_job(file_path, file_name)
296 
297        if not task_id:
298            result["message"] = "文档提交失败"
299            print(result["message"])
300            return result
301 
302        # 2. 等待任务完成
303        if not service.wait_for_completion(task_id):
304            result["message"] = "文档解析任务失败或超时"
305            print(result["message"])
306            return result
307 
308        # 3. 收集解析结果
309        print("开始收集解析结果...")
310        text = service.collect_all_results(task_id)
311 
312        if not text or not text.strip():
313            result["message"] = "文档内容为空"
314            print(result["message"])
315            return result
316 
317        print(f"解析到文本长度: {len(text)}")
318 
319        # 4. 文本切分
320        chunks = chunk_text(text, chunk_size=chunk_size)
321 
322        if not chunks:
323            result["message"] = "文档切分失败"
324            print(result["message"])
325            return result
326 
327        print(f"文档切分完成，共 {len(chunks)} 个切片")
328 
329        # 5. 生成向量嵌入
330        print("开始生成向量嵌入...")
331        embeddings = generate_embedding(chunks)
332 
333        if not embeddings:
334            result["message"] = "向量生成失败: 返回为空"
335            print(result["message"])
336            return result
337 
338        if len(embeddings) != len(chunks):
339            result["message"] = f"向量生成失败: 数量不匹配 ({len(embeddings)} vs {len(chunks)})"
340            print(result["message"])
341            return result
342 
343        print(f"向量生成完成，维度: {len(embeddings[0])}")
344 
345        # 6. 构建 Milvus 文档
346        #
347        # 身份一律取数据库主键，不再由文件名/内容派生（BC-53）：
348        #   doc_id   = 文档 UUID     —— 全局唯一，删除时可精确定位
349        #   kb_id    = 知识库 UUID   —— 真正可用于过滤的隔离键
350        #   id(主键) = <doc_id>_<切片序号> —— 跨知识库天然不碰撞
351        if not kb_id or not document_id:
352            result["message"] = (
353                "kb_id 与 document_id 为必填：切片身份必须来自数据库主键，"
354                "由文件名派生会让不同用户的同名文件产生相同主键（BC-53）"
355            )
356            print(result["message"])
357            return result
358 
359        documents = []
360        for i, (chunk, embedding) in enumerate(zip(chunks, embeddings)):
361            doc = {
362                "id": f"{document_id}_{i}",
363                "doc_id": str(document_id),
364                "kb_id": str(kb_id),
365                "filename": file_name,
366                "content": chunk,
367                "chunk_index": i,
368                "vector": embedding,
369            }
370            documents.append(doc)
371 
372        # 7. 插入 Milvus
373        print(f"开始插入 Milvus，集合: {index_name}")
374        milvus = get_milvus_service()
375        milvus.insert_documents(index_name, documents)
376 
377        result["success"] = True
378        result["message"] = f"成功处理 {len(documents)} 个切片"
379        result["document_count"] = len(documents)
380 
381        print(f"文档处理完成: {result['message']}")
382 
383    except Exception as e:
384        result["message"] = f"处理失败: {str(e)}"
385        print(f"文档处理异常: {e}")
386        import traceback
387        traceback.print_exc()
388 
389    return result
390

    174def _resolve_scope(
175    db: Session,
176    current_user: User,
177    kb_name: Optional[str],
178    search_local: bool,
179) -> list:
180    """
181    解析本次研究可检索的本地知识库。
182 
183    未启用本地检索时返回空列表——不去查库，也不会因此产生检索故障
184    （Scout 只在 `search_local=True` 时走本地路径）。
185 
186    ⚠️ 范围永远按**登录用户**解析，不接受客户端传集合名。
187    超级用户在这里也不放宽：检查点复核需要跨用户可见性，
188    而把别人上传的财报召回进自己的尽调报告是另一回事。
189    """
190    if not search_local:
191        return []
192    scope = resolve_kb_scope(db, str(current_user.id), kb_name)
193    if not scope.entries:
194        # 不在这里抛错：启用了本地检索却没有知识库是常见情形，
195        # 应当由 Scout 记为检索故障并写进报告，而不是让整个研究请求失败。
196        logger.warning(f"[research] 本地检索范围为空：{scope.failure_reason}")
197    return scope.as_state()
198

200def _assert_checkpoint_access(info: Dict[str, Any], current_user: User) -> None:
201    """检查点仅允许归属用户访问；超级用户承担跨用户复核/运维职责。"""
202    owner_id = info.get("user_id")
203    if current_user.is_superuser:
204        return
205    if not owner_id or str(owner_id) != str(current_user.id):
206        # 对历史遗留的无归属检查点同样失败关闭，不能把旧数据变成公共数据。
207        raise HTTPException(status_code=HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="无权访问该研究会话")

    586def collect_analysis_evidence(

590    section_id: str,

592    """校验一次 Scout 分析；事实与字段候选采用相同的来源/主体/日期闸门。
593 
594    ## 契约（BC-57 重画）
595 
596    模型**只提出锚点**：引用哪一条结果、字段是什么、取值/记录/期间是什么。
597    引文由系统用 `_build_quote_window` 从原文切出，`exact_quote` 不再由模型
598    回抄——模型擅长语义定位，不擅长充当无损字符串传输层。
599 
600    模型若仍在载荷里带了 `exact_quote`，一律**忽略**：接口改造不能顺手开出
601    一条新的信任路径。
602    """
603    if not state.get("due_diligence_mode"):
604        return
605 
606    # 原文定位只证明“这是原文”，还不等于对应清单字段已经核实。先把它标成
607    # RAG 候选；finalize 会在字段完成度/冲突检查后，只放行属于 verified
608    # 字段的事实。否则一条不完整财务片段会从 facts 侧门进入报告。
609    for candidate in analysis.get("extracted_facts", []):
610        common = _validate_source(state, candidate, results, section_id)
611        if not common:
612            continue
613        content = str(candidate.get("content") or "").strip()
614        if len(_verbatim_compact(content)) < 6:
615            _reject(state, "事实 content 过短，无法作为原文锚点", candidate, section_id)
616            continue
617        window, failure = _build_quote_window(common["source_text"], [content])
618        if window is None:
619            _reject(state, "事实内容无法在原文中定位", candidate, section_id, failure)
620            continue
621        common = {**common, "quote": window.quote}
622        url = str(common["result"].get("url") or "")
623        matched = next((fact for fact in reversed(state.get("facts", []))
624                        if fact.get("content") == content), None)
625        if matched:
626            matched["verified"] = False
627            matched["rag_evidence_candidate"] = True
628            matched["source_url"] = url
629            matched["source_name"] = common["result"].get("site_name") or matched.get("source_name")
630            # 来源等级不能继续采信模型自报分数。普通知识库上传件统一按“企业
631            # 提交材料，审计状态未由系统确认”处理；日后接文档元数据再细分。
632            matched["credibility_score"] = 0.6
633            matched["source_type"] = "local_document"
634            matched["metadata"] = {
635                **(matched.get("metadata") or {}),
636                "origin": "rag_text_document",
637                "source_id": common["source_id"],
638                "locator": common["locator"],
639                "exact_quote": common["quote"],
640                "as_of_date": common["publication_date"],
641            }
642 
643    for candidate in analysis.get("field_evidence", []):
644        field_id = str(candidate.get("field_id") or "")
645        if field_id not in CHECKLIST_BY_ID:
646            _reject(state, "field_id 不属于固定二十项清单", candidate, section_id)
647            continue
648        common = _validate_source(state, candidate, results, section_id)
649        if not common:
650            continue
651        source_text = common["source_text"]
652        value = candidate.get("value")
653        if value in (None, ""):
654            _reject(state, "候选未给出字段取值", candidate, section_id)
655            continue
656 
657        # 窗口锚点：字段取值 + 财务数值 + record 的全部关键值。
658        # 它们必须**同时**落在一段连续原文里，否则这不是一条可引用的记录。
659        anchors: List[Any] = [value]
660        if field_id in _FINANCIAL_KEYS and candidate.get("numeric_value") not in (None, ""):
661            anchors.append(candidate.get("numeric_value"))
662        record_keys = _RECORD_KEYS.get(field_id, ())
663        raw_record = candidate.get("record") if isinstance(candidate.get("record"), dict) else {}
664        anchors.extend(raw_record.get(key) for key in record_keys
665                       if raw_record.get(key) not in (None, ""))
666 
667        window, failure = _build_quote_window(source_text, anchors, _FIELD_TERMS[field_id])
668        if window is None:
669            _reject(state, "无法从原文切出证据窗口", candidate, section_id, failure)
670            continue
671        quote = window.quote
672        if not window.covered_terms:
673            # 与"模型改写"分开报告：这里模型没有做错任何事，是取值附近
674            # 确实没有该字段的确定性关键词，属于字段归属无法确认。
675            _reject(state, "取值近邻原文没有该字段的确定性关键词，字段归属无法确认",
676                    candidate, section_id)
677            continue
678        accepted = {**deepcopy(candidate), **common, "field_id": field_id, "quote": quote}
679        # 模型自报的引文一律丢弃：接口改造不得留下新的信任路径。
680        accepted.pop("exact_quote", None)
681        accepted.pop("source_text", None)
682 
683        if field_id in _FINANCIAL_KEYS:
684            period = str(candidate.get("period") or "").strip()
685            numeric = candidate.get("numeric_value")
686            if not period or numeric in (None, ""):
687                _reject(state, "财务候选缺少 period/numeric_value", candidate, section_id)
688                continue
689            try:
690                accepted["numeric_value"] = float(str(numeric).replace(",", ""))
691            except ValueError:
692                _reject(state, "numeric_value 不是数值", candidate, section_id)
693                continue
694            unit, unit_quote = _resolve_financial_unit(source_text, quote, numeric)
695            if not unit:
696                _reject(state, "原文中找不到该数值适用的单位表头", candidate, section_id)
697                continue
698            accepted["unit"] = unit
699            # 单位取自表头时，取证原文与数值不在同一窗口。两段都留档，
700            # 附录才能回答"这个万元是从哪一行读出来的"。
701            accepted["unit_quote"] = unit_quote
702        elif field_id in _SCENARIO_NUMERIC_FIELDS:
703            # 场景数值项：期间与单位同样必须来自原文，只是不投影进档案。
704            period = str(candidate.get("period") or "").strip()
705            numeric = candidate.get("numeric_value")
706            if not period or numeric in (None, ""):
707                _reject(state, "场景数值候选缺少 period/numeric_value", candidate, section_id)
708                continue
709            try:
710                accepted["numeric_value"] = float(str(numeric).replace(",", ""))
711            except ValueError:
712                _reject(state, "numeric_value 不是数值", candidate, section_id)
713                continue
714            unit, unit_quote = _resolve_financial_unit(source_text, quote, numeric)
715            if not unit:
716                _reject(state, "原文中找不到该数值适用的单位表头", candidate, section_id)
717                continue
718            accepted["unit"] = unit
719            accepted["unit_quote"] = unit_quote
720        elif field_id in PROFILE_BACKED_FIELDS and field_id != "operating_status":
721            record = _canonical_record(field_id, candidate, quote)
722            if record is None:
723                _reject(state, "评分字段缺少可由原文重建的结构化 record", candidate, section_id)
724                continue
725            accepted["canonical_record"] = record
726 
727        # —— 报表口径闸门 ——
728        #
729        # 放在最后：前面每一道（逐字、主体、单位、期间、record）都过了，
730        # 这一道才是唯一能拦住"数字真实但取自母公司报表"的。实测该缺陷
731        # 高估应收账款 8.2%，而所有既有闸门全部放行。
732        #
733        # `unknown` 放行：它只可能出现在文档第一个分节标题**之前**，即年报
734        # 正文/摘要/公告——那里按 A 股披露惯例讨论的就是合并口径，母公司
735        # 数据不会出现在那儿。但口径仍如实记录，附录要能回答"凭什么算合并"。
736        # 用窗口起点做位置：它由 `_locate_verbatim` 逐字定位得出，
737        # 比对 source_text 重新 find 更准（原文里有插入的空白与全半角差异）。
738        scope = resolve_in_chunk(
739            str(common["result"].get("statement_scope") or UNKNOWN),
740            common["result"].get("statement_scope_marks") or [],
741            window.start,
742        )
743        if field_id in CONSOLIDATED_REQUIRED_FIELDS and scope == PARENT:
744            _reject(state, "取自母公司报表，该字段要求合并口径", candidate, section_id,
745                    "母公司口径含对子公司内部往来，合并时抵消，不可用于本字段")
746            continue
747        accepted["statement_scope"] = scope
748        state.setdefault("rag_evidence_candidates", []).append(accepted)

751def _to_wanyuan(value: float, unit: str) -> float | int:
752    """换算到万元。口径定义在 `config.canonical`，本函数只做序列化适配。
753 
754    此前这里是本模块自己的一张 float 因子表，与评分器里的 `Decimal(v)/10`
755    构成同一规则的两份实现（BC-59 的根因）。现在两侧共用一处定义。
756    """
757    converted = to_wanyuan(value, unit)
758    if converted is None:
759        # 非金额单位（如百分比）不做换算，原值返回，与旧行为一致。
760        return int(value) if float(value).is_integer() else round(float(value), 4)
761    return as_number(converted)
762 
763 
764def _financial_comparable(field_id: str, row: Dict[str, Any]) -> Decimal:
765    """把财务候选归一到同一口径后再判断冲突。
766 
767    返回 Decimal：这个值要参与**相等判断**（同期间多源是否异值），
768    浮点尾差会把同一个金额判成冲突。
769    """
770    raw = Decimal(str(row["numeric_value"]))
771    unit = str(row.get("unit") or "")
772    if field_id == "debt_ratio":
773        is_percent = "%" in unit or "%" in str(row.get("value") or "")
774        return raw / Decimal("100") if is_percent else raw
775    converted = to_wanyuan(raw, unit or CANONICAL_MONEY_UNIT)
776    return converted if converted is not None else raw
777

779def _profile_display(field_id: str, patch: Dict[str, Any], checks: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
780    company = {"name": "RAG证据重放", **deepcopy(patch),
781               "coverage": {"queried": [field_id]}}
782    predicted = replay_from_profile(company, checks).get(field_id) or {}
783    if predicted.get("status") != "verified" or predicted.get("value") in (None, ""):
784        raise ValueError(f"字段 {field_id} 的 profile_patch 无法经生产映射重放")
785    return predicted["value"]

788def _deduplicate(candidates: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
789    seen = set()
790    result = []
791    for candidate in candidates:
792        key = (candidate.get("field_id"), candidate.get("source"), candidate.get("period"),
793               _compact(candidate.get("value")), _compact(candidate.get("quote")))
794        if key not in seen:
795            seen.add(key)
796            result.append(candidate)
797    return result
798

800def _term_in_quote(term: str, text: str) -> bool:
801    """完整度判据的措辞匹配，与字段关键词闸门**同一口径**。
802 
803    PDF 抽取会在词内插入空白：实测 `1年以内` 在 case_01 语料出现 0 次，
804    `1 年以内` 出现 11 次；`2024 年年度报告` 也是这么来的。字段关键词闸门走
805    `_verbatim_compact` 所以不受影响，而完整度判据原来用裸 `in`——
806    同一份原文，两处判据给出不同答案，且不一致的那一处会让该项永远不完整。
807 
808    与 BC-60 同因：判据里的字面量必须按真实文档校准，**并且**匹配方式要和
809    别处一致。"我们已经处理过这个问题"处理的是那一个入口。
810    """
811    return _verbatim_compact(term) in _verbatim_compact(text)
812

1119        if not fact.get("rag_evidence_candidate"):
1120            continue
1121        metadata = fact.get("metadata") or {}
1122        fact_quote = _compact(metadata.get("exact_quote"))
1123        fact["verified"] = any(
1124            metadata.get("source_id") == source_id
1125            and metadata.get("locator") == locator
1126            and fact_quote
1127            and (fact_quote in evidence_quote or evidence_quote in fact_quote)
1128            for source_id, locator, evidence_quote in allowed_quotes
1129        )
1130 
1131    state["completeness"] = compute_completeness(checks)
1132    state["rag_evidence_summary"] = counts
1133    return counts

1235def _material_date_state(material: MaterialDescriptor) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
1236    """Select the latest concrete fact date without relabelling its meaning."""
1237 
1238    candidates: list[tuple[str, date]] = [
1239        (kind, value)
1240        for kind, value in (
1241            ("document_date", material.document_date),
1242            ("publication_date", material.publication_date),
1243            ("observed_at", material.observed_at),
1244        )
1245        if value is not None
1246    ]
1247    if material.reporting_period is not None:
1248        candidates.append(("reporting_period_end", material.reporting_period.end_date))
1249    if candidates:
1250        # The list order makes equal-date ties stable while preserving the exact
1251        # semantic kind of the selected material date.
1252        kind, value = max(enumerate(candidates), key=lambda item: (item[1][1], -item[0]))[1]
1253        return kind, value.isoformat()
1254    return "unknown", None
1255 
1256 
1257def load_due_diligence_case_package(
1258    case_root: str | Path,
1259) -> LoadedDueDiligenceCasePackage:
1260    """Load a case and materialise only the loader-authorized material bytes.
1261 
1262    This is the sole filesystem boundary for the offline case-material retriever.
1263    It first calls :func:`load_due_diligence_case`, then resolves each *already
1264    validated* descriptor through the existing anti-traversal/anti-symlink
1265    resolver and repeats the required SHA-256 check while reading the bytes.
1266    No caller downstream receives ``case_root``.
1267    """
1268 
1269    case = load_due_diligence_case(case_root)
1270    root = _package_root(case_root)
1271    entities = {entity.entity_id: entity for entity in case.entities}
1272    authorized: list[AuthorizedCaseMaterial] = []
1273 
1274    for material in case.materials:
1275        # The general loader permits an absent digest for backwards-compatible
1276        # metadata validation.  An auditable RAG corpus cannot: without a
1277        # declared digest, later readers cannot prove which material was used.
1278        if material.sha256 is None:
1279            raise CaseValidationError(
1280                f"material {material.material_id} requires sha256 for authorized RAG materialisation"
1281            )
1282        path = _resolve_declared_input(root, material.relative_path)
1283        content = path.read_bytes()
1284        actual_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
1285        if actual_sha256 != material.sha256:
1286            raise CaseValidationError(
1287                f"material {material.material_id} sha256 changed after production validation"
1288            )
1289 
1290        entity = entities.get(material.subject_entity_id)
1291        if entity is None:  # Defensive: DueDiligenceCase has already checked it.
1292            raise CaseValidationError(
1293                f"material {material.material_id} references an unknown subject entity"
1294            )
1295        date_kind, factual_date = _material_date_state(material)
1296        period = material.reporting_period
1297        authorized.append(AuthorizedCaseMaterial(
1298            case_id=case.manifest.case_id,
1299            subject_entity_id=material.subject_entity_id,
1300            subject_name=entity.name,
1301            material_id=material.material_id,
1302            material_type=material.material_type,
1303            relative_path=material.relative_path,
1304            content_bytes=content,
1305            sha256=actual_sha256,
1306            provenance=material.provenance,
1307            source_channel=material.source_channel.value,
1308            issuer=material.issuer,
1309            cutoff_date=case.manifest.cutoff_date.isoformat(),
1310            date_kind=date_kind,
1311            factual_date=factual_date,
1312            document_date=(material.document_date.isoformat()
1313                           if material.document_date is not None else None),
1314            publication_date=(material.publication_date.isoformat()
1315                              if material.publication_date is not None else None),
1316            observed_at=(material.observed_at.isoformat()
1317                         if material.observed_at is not None else None),
1318            reporting_period_start=(period.start_date.isoformat() if period is not None else None),
1319            reporting_period_end=(period.end_date.isoformat() if period is not None else None),
1320            date_unknown_reason=material.date_unknown_reason,
1321        ))
1322 
1323    package = LoadedDueDiligenceCasePackage(case=case, materials=tuple(authorized))
1324    _register_package_seal(package)
1325    return validate_loaded_due_diligence_case_package(package)
